notes.title: Dev Blog #15: The Art of Void Future - Part 2
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello agents,[/b][/p][p]In our last blog we shared the philosophy behind the art of [i]Void Future[/i]: a world where technology is chunky, lived-in, and patched together with scraps of the past. Today, we want to go deeper, straight into the streets of [b]Heaven[/b], where every wire, wall, and screen tells a story.[/p][p][/p][h3]Wired for Survival[/h3][p]Electricity is life in the underground. From rusted breaker boxes to patched-up power modules, every prop is designed to feel like it was built for necessity, not beauty. You’ll see scratched surfaces, warning labels, and flickering lights, visual cues that not only sell the atmosphere but also help players quickly read what’s interactive.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/97af2b9938d52b895c83200e34f4d0219143bbba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Streets of Heaven[/h3][p]Heaven is not a city of shining towers, but of crumbling facades and improvised architecture. We’ve built modular street elements: doors, windows, storefronts, meant to be reused and rearranged, just like real neighborhoods scarred by time. Neon strips clash with dirty concrete, while subtle details like rust and grime make every corner feel grounded.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/27a13d3b7383b26cb9ed0619dd274ad92e391cc2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/49578578ddf5140577a6c2d00dcf52e93724ae5c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/e37490e1a61bcbe1a87efcd2f251401b7f1348ca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Tactile Tech[/h3][p]From handheld devices to retro terminals, we wanted the hardware in [i]Void Future[/i] to feel tactile. Buttons are oversized, screens glow with cold light, and every edge shows wear. These aren’t showroom machines, they’re tools of survival, hacked together to do one job: work.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/85b57ede03ee6c1ebe0f744e5068484d08674305.png"][/img][/p][h3]Building a Believable Dystopia[/h3][p]Every asset, from the smallest fuse box to the largest street façade, reinforces our goal: immersion in a world that feels broken, recycled, but functional. It’s not clean sci-fi, it’s [i]Void Future[/i].[/p][p]Stay tuned for more dev updates, and if you haven’t already, add [i]Void Future[/i] to your wishlist to support development.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478560/void_future/"][/dynamiclink]- The Void Future Team[/p]

In fact, it’s already begun. We’ve gone back to the design table, and changes are already in progress to make [i]Void Future[/i] a better, more immersive experience. Your input has given us clarity on what needs improvement and what players enjoy the most.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just one step in the journey. More updates, improvements, and surprises are on the way, and we can’t wait to share them with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, if you haven’t yet, we warmly invite you to [b]join our Discord community[/b]. That’s where we’ll be posting behind-the-scenes updates, WIP content, and where you can directly share your thoughts with us. notes.title: Dev Blog #14: The Art of Void Future - Part 1
notes.content: [p]Hello agents,[/p][p]Today we want to show you a glimpse behind the neon-lit veil of [i]Void Future[/i], where art and function collide in a stylized cyberpunk vision of the year 2045. As a hacker navigating a world ruled by corporate shadow wars and surveillance states, we wanted your surroundings to reflect both decay and precision, a world falling apart and holding together at the same time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Stylized Functionality[/h3][p]We’ve chosen a [b]stylized realism[/b] approach for our 3D assets. Think [i]clean silhouettes[/i], [i]grime-covered surfaces[/i], and [i]designs that hint at utility[/i]. Our tech isn’t meant to look sleek and futuristic. It’s chunky, scratched, repaired with tape, retrofitted, and above all, believable.[/p][p][/p][p]Devices like the hacking terminals and portable readers you encounter are grounded in purpose. We’ve drawn inspiration from real-world industrial designs, infusing them with glowing trims and exaggerated forms to make them stand out in gameplay, without breaking immersion.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/3e3777e4b12d8fabae5bc58e2a6ebb5fa1d14a10.png"][/img][/p][h3]Tactile Tech, Built for Use[/h3][p]Our props are designed to feel heavy, functional, and visibly used. Each piece of equipment has a physicality to it: scratched surfaces, exposed screws, labels worn by time. Whether you're connecting to an old data port or interfacing with a legacy terminal, the hardware is unmistakably industrial and lived-in.[/p][p]We focus on believable, grounded tech, port access units, and modular electronics that look like they were built for field operatives, not showrooms.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/c6d3ca3e67bf2128a2bbb6311e8155247d9f2247.png"][/img][/p][h3]Surveillance, Control, and Resistance[/h3][p]As the player explores and disrupts a tightly monitored world, they'll encounter various security devices like cameras and electric fences, all carefully crafted to balance readability and atmosphere.[/p][p]We deliberately avoided ultra-sleek sci-fi shapes. Instead, the tech in [i]Void Future[/i] feels [b]patched, reused, recycled[/b], in line with the underground and decaying urban spaces you navigate.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/262468d22e9ad714b9aa53642874adbc5c33b9c8.png"][/img][/p][h3]Setting the Mood[/h3][p]Environments in [i]Void Future[/i] are brought to life with bold lighting and a distinct palette: rust tones clashing with neon accents, dim industrial corridors illuminated by soft emissions. Each scene reinforces the dystopian tension at the heart of the game: [b]you're never fully safe[/b], and always being watched.[/p][p]The city is both decayed and digitized, a perfect contradiction. The screenshots below show how we balance color, architecture, and lighting to maintain this mood.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478560/void_future/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Final Thoughts[/h2][p][i]Void Future[/i] is more than a hacking simulator, it’s a world built from secrets, wires, and decay. Through stylized assets and atmospheric design, our goal is to immerse players in a universe that feels as functional as it is broken.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more dev updates , and remember: [i]access is never granted, only taken[/i].[/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog #13: Meet Nyx the Mercenary You Don’t Want to Cross
notes.content:
[p]Hello hackers,[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who played our demo, you might remember her from the intro.
Silent. Precise. Unstoppable.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Nyx[/b] is a name whispered in the underground, a mercenary who never fails a job, and never answers questions. Her past? Unknown. Her motivations? Private. What we do know is that when she shows up, things [i]get done[/i]. Fast.[/p][p]She’s not a hacker. She doesn’t need to be.
Nyx brings muscle, instinct, and surgical efficiency to a world ruled by code. She’s the one you call when stealth and brute force need to happen in the same breath.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Cold. Controlled. And always three steps ahead.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]She’s striking, calculated, and dangerously effective. Dressed for utility, never for comfort, but never ignoring the power of appearance. Nyx doesn’t just use weapons. She is one.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/032db525e7c1b2340d678bcfc44bf601e6948bd4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/b3990c57c093d03feb557b1f330ff04e87b3922f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/1ff074202740ce3f1d3699e9c8bf7a385f368f57.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Make sure to follow us for dev updates, character reveals, and behind-the-scenes content.
Don’t forget to wishlist [b][i]Void Future[/i][/b] on Steam.
Because Nyx? She’ll be waiting.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478560/void_future/"][/dynamiclink]📸 Follow us on [url="https://"]https://x.com/voidfuturegame[/url][/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog #12: Reflecting on the Demo & What’s Next
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a little over two weeks since we launched the first public demo of Void Future — and the response has been incredible. Thank you to everyone who played it, shared thoughts, reported bugs, or just dropped by to wishlist the game. Your support means the world to us.

[h3]🎮 What We’ve Learned[/h3]
In that short time, we’ve received a ton of valuable feedback — both technical and creative.
Some of our core ideas were validated (which is always reassuring!), but we also got insightful comments about mechanics that weren’t entirely clear, and moments that didn’t feel as fun or engaging as we hoped.

We also had the chance to speak with a few publishers who are potentially interested in the project — another exciting step forward for our tiny team.

[h3]🛠️ What We’re Changing[/h3]
As a result of this feedback, we’ve made a few important decisions:

– We’re reworking the opening section of the game to better guide new players, clarify the core loop, and make sure the experience is intuitive and immersive from the very start.
– We’re shifting the release date toward the end of the year — this will give us the time we need to deliver something richer and more polished.
– We’ll be removing the current demo from Steam soon so we can improve it behind the scenes and bring it back in a more refined form later on.

[h3]🚀 What’s Next[/h3]
These changes are all about delivering a better experience. We want Void Future to be more than just a cool idea — we want it to be a game that truly pulls you into its world and keeps you there.

Thank you again for being part of this journey with us. We’ll be sharing more updates soon — and if you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist the game to stay in the loop!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478560/void_future/

Stay tuned,
— The Void Future Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #6: The Art of Staying Hidden
notes.content:
In Void Future, information is the most valuable currency—and the most dangerous liability. Every move you make in the digital world leaves a trace, and in a society where every action is monitored, even the smallest mistake can cost you everything. Today, we're diving into the detection system and how players must outsmart the omnipresent surveillance networks to survive.

[b]Digital Shadows – How Detection Works[/b]

Unlike traditional stealth mechanics where crouching in a dark corner might save you, Void Future operates on an entirely different level: network visibility. Every action you take online is logged, analyzed, and tracked by advanced AI-driven security systems. Simply connecting to a server is enough to alert watchful eyes. Once your presence is logged, your IP address becomes a breadcrumb leading directly back to you.

A detection meter tracks how much attention you're drawing. Each reckless action—breaching a server, bypassing a firewall, cracking encrypted data—pushes you closer to being discovered. When the meter reaches 100%, it's over. The system pinpoints your location, authorities are dispatched, and the game ends. Staying ahead of detection isn’t just a suggestion—it’s survival.

Staying One Step Ahead

So how do you operate in the shadows of a hyper-connected world? You have a few tools at your disposal:

[b]1. Wipe Your Footprints – Deleting Logs[/b]

Every server you infiltrate keeps a detailed log of who accessed it and when. Leaving this data untouched is a death sentence. Before disconnecting, you must manually erase these logs, covering your tracks before security systems flag your presence. However, time is a luxury—cleaning logs takes precious seconds, and sometimes you need a faster way to disappear.

[b]2. Bounce Your Signal – Masking Your Presence[/b]

The more direct your connection, the faster you're detected. That’s where bounced links come into play. Once you've fully compromised a server, you can repurpose it as a proxy—rerouting your connection through it to mask your origin. The more bounces you chain together, the harder it is for security to trace you. However, each bounce adds latency, slowing down your hacks and increasing risk. It’s a delicate balance between security and efficiency.

A Living, Breathing Cyberworld

The detection system isn’t just a gameplay mechanic—it’s a core part of Void Future’s worldbuilding. Security isn’t an arbitrary obstacle; it’s a realistic response to a society obsessed with control. The omnipresence of digital tracking reflects the dystopian reality of 2045, where privacy is a relic of the past.

How you navigate this world is up to you. Do you take your time, carefully erasing logs and covering your tracks? Or do you push your luck, moving quickly and trusting your skill to keep you ahead of the watchdogs? The choice is yours—but remember, they are always watching.

Stay sharp, and stay hidden.

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today, we’re diving deep into the world of Void Future, a city teetering on the edge between technological marvel and total control.

🕶️ [b]A Glimpse into 2045[/b]
The story of Void Future unfolds in the not-so-distant future of 2045. This world isn’t a neon-soaked fantasy or a far-fetched sci-fi utopia. Instead, it is a dark projection of our current societal trajectory. Towering glass and metal skyscrapers pierce a smoggy sky, surveillance screens pulse with targeted ads, and narrow alleys hold secrets in their shadows. The city breathes a cold, calculated air where human warmth feels scarce.

🛰️ [b]Technology: Grounded Yet Unforgiving[/b]
Technology in Void Future is advanced but remains within the realm of possibility. Drones buzz through the air, especially those operated by law enforcement, keeping a watchful eye on crowded streets and forgotten neighborhoods alike. The world is deeply interconnected—every device, every interaction leaves a trace. With everyone's digital fingerprint constantly exposed, it has become nearly impossible to go off the grid. Privacy is an illusion, and those who try to hide often find themselves under the harshest spotlight.

🚷 [b]Living Under the Digital Eye[/b]
In this world, personal freedom is a relic of the past. Every individual has a digital footprint, a comprehensive record of their entire life—medical history, financial transactions, social interactions—all seamlessly accessible by those in power. It's a society where a single misstep can trigger an alert, where the line between reality and the digital realm is blurred.

🎨 [b]Art and Atmosphere[/b]
Visually, Void Future draws inspiration from a blend of cyberpunk and contemporary dystopian aesthetics. The environments mix gritty realism with stylized pixel-inspired elements, creating a world that feels both familiar and unsettling. From the dim glow of holographic ads to the stark, sterile lighting of corporate lobbies, every scene is crafted to immerse you in a narrative of control and resistance.

We hope this gives you a taste of what’s to come. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Follow us on social media, add Void Future to your Steam wishlist, and keep an eye out for our upcoming demo!

Until next time, stay safe—digitally and otherwise.

— The Void Future Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #4: How Hacking Works
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A new week, a new devblog.
Today, we’re diving into one of the core aspects of Void Future: hacking.

[b]The Power of the Digital Underground[/b]
In Void Future, the protagonist—and by extension, you—possesses the most valuable skill in a world where megacorporations rule from the shadows, technology dictates society, and the divide between the privileged and the forgotten has never been greater: hacking.

This skill isn’t just a tool; it’s your weapon, your key to survival, and your only means of exposing the truth.

[b]Introducing GhostWire OS[/b]
To navigate this dystopian landscape, you’ll be using GhostWire OS, a system designed by the infamous underground hacking collective GhostWire. Built for infiltration and digital warfare, it comes preloaded with specialized tools tailored for cyber-intrusion and high-stakes espionage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/00c51d4c000eb99ae5a1f9fe53142bef5e51158a.gif[/img]

[b]Some of the key utilities include:[/b]

[b]Server Scan[/b] – An essential tool for mapping vulnerabilities. It scans a target location and reveals available entry points.

[b]Firewall Bypass[/b] – A powerful exploit that temporarily disables firewalls, giving you a window of opportunity to operate undetected.

[b]Password Breaker[/b] – A brute-force password generator utilizing advanced cryptographic algorithms, ensuring even the longest, most complex passwords can be cracked—given enough time.

[b]A Hacker’s Toolkit: Built for All Players[/b]
Hacking in Void Future is executed through direct terminal commands, typed manually by the player. But don’t worry—you won’t need to be a real-life cybersecurity expert to enjoy the game.

We’ve designed the system to be intuitive, balancing immersion with accessibility. Many commands are inspired by real-world hacking practices, but we’ve streamlined them to keep the experience engaging rather than overwhelming. This isn’t a hacking simulator—it’s a story-driven cyberpunk thriller where hacking is your primary way to interact with the world.

[b]More Than Just a Terminal[/b]
Not all systems rely purely on text-based terminals. Some high-security networks feature graphical user interfaces, offering unique challenges and interactions. Depending on the server you infiltrate, you may encounter different tools and obstacles requiring a mix of logic, strategy, and quick thinking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481835/12dfd1dd12f465e3f7db4ddfd2493a41eebd1e68.gif[/img]

Of course, this is just the beginning. There are plenty of other elements we haven’t revealed yet, but for now, we’ll keep them under wraps.

Stay connected, and don’t forget to follow us here on Steam and on our social channels for the latest updates. Every follow, wishlist, and comment helps us a lot as a small indie team just getting started!

Until next time—stay in the shadows, and keep hacking.

— The Void Future Team
